uncited: **Transmittance Calculation**: Compute the accumulated transmittance $T_i = \exp\left(-\int_0^{t_i} \sigma(\tau) d\tau\right)$ for each sample, representing the probability of light traveling from the camera to the sample point without absorption or scattering [G: Standard volume rendering transmittance definition].
*   Use when training speed is a priority and a slight drop in reconstruction quality is acceptable.
*   Use in voxel-based architectures where density evaluation is faster than radiance evaluation.
It is part of the effort to make differentiable volume rendering more efficient, specifically targeting the bottleneck of evaluating radiance fields for every sample point along a ray.
